info.title: Carmen Cloud API
info.description: The Carmen Cloud API: workspaces and their members, API keys, Stripe billing sessions, usage reports, stored recognition events and Storage & Hooks settings. Mounted at the `workspace` base path of the shared API domain — public paths are `/workspace/…` while this document's operation paths are relative to the base path. The per-workspace routes authenticate with a workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header — API keys are exchanged for one at `POST /auth/token`. Bearer scopes are baked into the token at issue time, so newly granted workspaces or roles need a token refresh. (The workspace-collection and invitation routes are used by the Carmen Cloud console, authenticate with AWS SigV4, and are not part of the API-key surface.)

get.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope. Enriched with the Stripe customer and pending-payment state when the workspace has a Stripe customer.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

put.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope. Only the workspace owner may rename — the human owner, or a key-minted token whose API key carries the `owner` role in this workspace (rename is a management *capability*, so machine principals qualify).

400.description: Missing name, or the caller is not the owner.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

patch.summary: Cancel or renew a product subscription
patch.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope. Applies the requested Stripe subscription action; cancellations may attach the configured retention coupon.

200.description: The workspace with the updated subscription state.

400.description: Unknown product, or the workspace has no Stripe billing set up.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

delete.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope. A *governance* operation: only the owner's own user session may call it — key-minted (machine) bearer tokens are refused with 403 regardless of the key's role. Refused while subscriptions are active or purchased credits remain. A workspace that was ever billed is archived (members and keys deactivated but kept); one that never was is deleted outright with its members and keys.

200.description: The workspace was archived or deleted.

400.description: Active subscriptions or remaining purchased credits block the deletion.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

get.summary: Get one API key's daily usage
get.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the range (inclusive), `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC). Defaults to the start of the current UTC month.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the range (inclusive), `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC). Defaults to today. The range must not exceed 366 days.

200.description: The daily usage report of the key.

400.description: Malformed `from`/`to` date or `apiKeyId`, inverted range, or a range longer than 366 days.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

put.summary: Select the billing account and maintain product invoice PO numbers
put.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope. On first use, provisions a Stripe customer and permanently locks the workspace to the selected billing account. Later calls may update or remove each product PO number without changing the region.

400.description: Invalid input, or an attempt to change a locked region.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

get.summary: List stored events of an API
get.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Returns the stored events of one API of the workspace, paged and time-bounded. Events are retained for 24 hours; `before`/`after` are clamped to the retention window.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace. Must match the workspace of the bearer token — the authorizer rejects calls for foreign workspaces.

parameters.name: api
parameters.description: The API whose stored events to list, e.g. `vehicle`.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order by storage time: `asc` or `desc`. Default `desc`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only events stored at or before this epoch-millisecond timestamp. Overrides `after`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only events stored at or after this epoch-millisecond timestamp. Defaults to the start of the retention window.

parameters.name: continuation-token
parameters.description: The `continuationToken` of the previous page, to continue listing.

200.description: One page of stored events (possibly empty).

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or a token for another workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

get.summary: Preview the next invoice for a metered subscription
get.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope. Combines Stripe's upcoming subscription invoice with the latest complete hourly usage available to the production overage calculator. No Stripe invoice or invoice item is created.

400.description: The product is not a supported metered subscription.

404.description: No such workspace, Stripe customer, or matching subscription.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

Creates the SNS subscription and sends the confirmation request to the endpoint; the hook stays `pending_confirmation` until the endpoint confirms it. Re-posting a pending URL resends the confirmation. At most 10 hooks per workspace.

get.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Returns the workspace's per-API storage toggles and its SNS topic ARN (when webhooks exist).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace. Must match the workspace of the bearer token — the authorizer rejects calls for foreign workspaces.

patch.summary: Enable or disable event storage per API
patch.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Applies the requested toggles. Disabling an API cascades onto the webhooks: the API is removed from every hook's subscription, hooks left without APIs are deleted, and the workspace topic is removed with its last hook.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace. Must match the workspace of the bearer token — the authorizer rejects calls for foreign workspaces.

200.description: The storage settings after the update.

400.description: One or more API names are invalid.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or a token for another workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

A *governance* operation: only the owner's own user session may call it — key-minted (machine) bearer tokens are refused with 403 regardless of the key's role. Only the owner may transfer, and only to an active `ADMIN` member.

parameters.description: Cognito user id of the new owner.

put.summary: Turn the usage hard cap ("Stop at plan limit") on or off
put.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope. Per metered product. While on, recognition requests are rejected (HTTP 403 at the gateway within a minute, `429 Limit exceeded` from the API until then) once the lookups included in the plan are used up in the billing period, and no overage is charged for that period from the moment the cap was switched on; optionally the workspace's prepaid credits are used instead. Overage already accumulated before enabling stays billable. Requires a signed-in user session (not an API-key-minted token).

200.description: The stored setting and the real-time cap status.

400.description: Invalid input, no active subscription for the product, or the included lookup count is unknown.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).

delete.description: Authenticated with the workspace bearer token in the `Authorization` header; the caller needs a matching workspace scope. Pending invitations are cancelled; active members are removed. The owner cannot be removed.

400.description: The target is the workspace owner.

403.description: Missing or invalid bearer token, or the token grants no access to this workspace (rejected by the authorizer).
